links.outcome: Research team review of AI responses to simulated patient questions as thumbs up/down/neither
links.effect: All 75 questions answered; 65 (86.7%) thumbs-up, 10 (13.3%) marked neither due to convoluted or incomplete information; none rated thumbs down.
links.quote: Of these, 65 responses (86.7%) received "thumbs-up" ratings, indicating that they were comprehensive, while 10 responses (13.3%) were marked as "neither" due to convoluted or incomplete information.

unlisted_practices: Grounding a patient-education chatbot on a curated set of 50 scholarly articles

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed patient-facing AI Q&A application for sternotomy discharge education using simulated questions and expert rating, without comparing or testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
